question: Which of the following about phenytoin is true ?

options.opc: It is excreted unchanged in urine

reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "Phenytoin" -> "zero order kinetics" -> "constant rate of elimination" -> "saturation of metabolic pathways" -> 90%
CHAIN: "Phenytoin" -> "hepatic enzyme inducer" -> "increased metabolism of other drugs" -> 95%
CHAIN: "Phenytoin" -> "metabolized in liver" -> "not excreted unchanged in urine" -> 95%
analysis: Phenytoin is an antiepileptic drug that is known to follow zero-order kinetics at therapeutic doses, meaning that its rate of metabolism is constant regardless of its concentration. It is a hepatic enzyme inducer, which can affect the metabolism of other drugs. Phenytoin is not excreted unchanged in the urine; it is extensively metabolized in the liver. Additionally, phenytoin is known to be teratogenic, associated with fetal hydantoin syndrome when used during pregnancy.
